INVOKER-QUAS_COMMAND_STONE.title: Quas Command Stone
INVOKER-QUAS_COMMAND_STONE.description: Start combat with QQQ. Each turn start, choose 1 orb to channel ([blue]Quas[/blue]/[yellow]Wex[/yellow]/[red]Exort[/red]). Enhances: Cold Snap, Ghost Walk, Ice Wall.
INVOKER-WEX_COMMAND_STONE.title: Wex Command Stone
INVOKER-WEX_COMMAND_STONE.description: Start combat with WWW. Each turn start, choose 1 orb to channel ([blue]Quas[/blue]/[yellow]Wex[/yellow]/[red]Exort[/red]). Enhances: Tornado, EMP, Alacrity.
INVOKER-EXORT_COMMAND_STONE.title: Exort Command Stone
INVOKER-EXORT_COMMAND_STONE.description: Start combat with EEE. Each turn start, choose 1 orb to channel ([blue]Quas[/blue]/[yellow]Wex[/yellow]/[red]Exort[/red]). Enhances: Forge Spirit, Chaos Meteor, Sun Strike.
INVOKER-AGHANIMS_SCEPTER.title: Aghanim's Scepter
INVOKER-AGHANIMS_SCEPTER.description: When you play Invoke, add 2 spell cards to hand instead of 1.
INVOKER-AGHANIMS_SCEPTER.flavor: The scepter hums with arcane potential.
INVOKER-AGHANIMS_FRAGMENT.title: Aghanim's Fragment
INVOKER-AGHANIMS_FRAGMENT.description: At the start of each turn, 25% chance to add a random Invoker spell to your hand.
INVOKER-AGHANIMS_FRAGMENT.flavor: A shard of the scepter's power.
